programs.title: Fixer To Fabulous
programs.desc: A couple with family ties to Peru have purchased a small house they want to make their forever home, but it needs a lot of work. Dave and Jenny brighten up the home and incorporate a Peruvian design-style with personal touches and a chicken coop.

programs.title: 100 Day Dream Home
programs.desc: Mika and Brian create a family's dream home in the backyard of a childhood home. They aim to give them all the amenities without going over budget.

programs.title: Australia's Best Pools
programs.desc: Dave is over in Perth to see what's best in the west, Dave and Jess visit a retreat in Northern NSW and Dave shows off what he's done on his own home!

programs.title: My Lottery Dream Home
programs.desc: A professional poker player is ready to purchase a huge family home in Philadelphia. He wants David Bromstad to find him a modern house with unique features.

programs.title: Home Town
programs.sub_title: There's Just Something About A Porch
programs.desc: A couple is looking for a historic home in the country with a porch and plenty of green space. Ben and Erin transform their new home into a classic, dogtrot-style house full of historic charm and Southern touches.

programs.title: Good Bones
programs.desc: Mina and Karen are back in Old Southside where they've purchased a hoarder house filled with garbage and hiding fire damage. As demo gets underway, they uncover a slew of other issues as they turn this trash-filled home into an updated Victorian beauty.
